notes.title: Online Multiplayer Crash
notes.content:
[b]Update: This crash only occurs on Windows 10 build 15063 when launching through Steam. A temporary workaround has been found. Please launch the game directly through the .exe instead of launching through Steam. Disabling VSync may also fix this issue in some cases.[/b]

Hello,

I'm currently investigating a bug that causes players to crash when trying to load online multiplayer games. This bug seems to affect a small percentage of players and I have been unable to reproduce it so far.

If you have been effected by this bug, please add me on Steam.

Thanks,
David
